method: Real application-owned GLFW windows and MuJoCo mjv/mjr rendering. PRESS, RELEASE, REPEAT and focus events are injected into the registered GLFW callbacks from the render thread, then consumed by the production input queue. No OS-level input automation and no manual keyboard claim.
scope: Window rendering/lifecycle, action-state input semantics, no-repeat hold, release/focus/stop/pause/reset, independent leg height keys, one-shot jump, jump height-edit freeze and scene changes. Headless motion cases separately measure true closed-loop turning and braking; not hardware validation.
